periods.final: Full game; full-game observed regular groups explicitly include overtime in names. Outright also uses final; final alone is insufficient.
periods.1st: First half, distinct from q1. Inferred from basketball market names, line magnitudes and PM same-event comparisons; no official RAY protocol specification obtained.
periods.q3: Third quarter; English names explicitly say 3rd Quarter only.

tags.ou: Total points; distinguish game total vs T1/T2 team total using group ID

status.1: Open at source; execution additionally requires enable_parlay==1, valid odds and stake limits.
status.4: Not eligible for execution; all 106 observed rows have win=-1. Local collector excludes status 4. This code alone does not prove settlement, match end, or irreversible deletion.
status.5: In this sample all 902 rows have win in {0,1}; settled/result rows. Not executable. Other settlement variants remain unverified.

round.bo4: Observed competition-format label; basketball four-quarter interpretation, not current period or best-of series. Current numeric collector coercion returns zero.
round.bo1: Observed on outright entries; round alone is not sufficient to classify a real two-team game.

recognitionRules.matchKind: Do not rely on game_id alone: exclude outright (tag/group and entrant structure) and NBA2K/Esports Battle before real-basketball matching.
recognitionRules.sourceIdentity: Preserve match_id + odds_id as the option identity and retain raw group/stage/value/team fields.
recognitionRules.marketIdentity: RAY | match_id | explicit period | market kind | team_ref (for team totals) | overtime policy | canonical signed T1 spread or unsigned points total.
recognitionRules.spreadDirection: Canonical handicap is relative to Ray team.pos=1. A row for pos=2 has its signed raw value negated. Never group by abs(value) alone.
recognitionRules.totalsDirection: Parse > as over and < as under; team_id==0 is expected and cannot identify the side or team-total target.
recognitionRules.teamTotals: T1/T2 refer to Ray team.pos=1/2; after venue team alignment this may be reversed relative to PM display.
recognitionRules.unknowns: Unknown group, stage, unsupported value syntax, or incomplete pair stays unrecognized/locked; never silently map to full game.
recognitionRules.integerLines: Integer spreads/totals were observed. Exact-score pushes/refunds and cancellation rules need separate settlement proof; do not assume half-point binary payout.

websocket.interpretation: Observed WS payloads contain id, match_id, odds, status and last_update, without group/stage/value/team identity. Build baseline from HTTP then join by option ID; unknown IDs require HTTP refresh. Observation supports realtime updates beyond winner markets.

canonicalCodeVerification.note: Executed bundled current repository functions without modifying product code. Expanded regex with no gameCode intentionally simulates opening collection only, not a proposed fix.

limitations: This sample proves 22 observed group codes only. Codes for q2, q4, second half, special props or additional leagues are not inferred from adjacent IDs.
Source odds and bet_limit are source quote/limit fields, not guarantees of account-specific acceptance or fill. No orders or authenticated account prechecks were submitted.
Basketball period and BO labels are separate. Do not apply esports map or series-win rules.
All normal-play hedges still require identical settlement scope and complete outcome coverage, including push and cancellation behavior.

codeFindings.issue: Basketball allowlist only winner group; expanding filter alone does not add market normalization.
Rows merge by group ID alone; canonical replay collapses six spread lines to one row.
Side assignment uses event team_id only; canonical replay produces empty sides for totals team_id=0.
1st and q1 both become Map=1; unknown/overtime strings become 0.
Number(bo4) falls back to zero. Basketball period count needs sport-specific semantics.
Realtime handler ignores IDs not previously registered and updates prices/locks only; new lines need HTTP baseline refresh.
Production collector currently reads match_type=2 page=1 only; the all-page audit is broader than production discovery.
Generic CollectBetDto lacks explicit market kind, line, period scope and target team fields.
Legacy mapSaveBetRows keeps no market-code/line/period fields and deduplicates source match + source bet ID; reusing group ID loses lines. BetName containing + is filtered.
Matcher takes winner sources and picks one source per numeric Map; no line dimension.
Precheck correctly looks up odds_id and transmits raw value/tag/stage. This does not validate a newly introduced candidate market identity or settlement compatibility.
Football-specific normalizer uses abs(line) for grouping. Do not reuse unchanged for basketball, where opposite signed handicaps can coexist.
